content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: M.Sc. Fruit Science / PhD Fruit Science. Preference will be given to NET qualified candidates. Age limit: 35 years for men and 40 years for women Age relaxation: women 40, SC/ST/OBC Relatable as per Government of India rules Other conditions: Degree programme must be completed from ICAR/UGC recognized University/Institute. The post is purely on temporary/contractual basis. Desirable: Relevant research experience as evidenced from fellowship/associateship/training/other engagements.

content_sections.heading: NAU Young Professional-II Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will be responsible for the following duties: Survey data collection. DUS characterization compilation. Statistical analysis and preparation of documents/reports etc. Knowledge of fruit crops and its various agronomical aspects and.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 27 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in NAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Young Professional-II.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for NAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (NAU website www.nau.in) and send it to The Principal, ASPEE College of Horticulture, Navsari Agricultural University, Eru Char Rasta, Dandi Road, Navsari - 396450, Gujarat, by paper application along with attested certificates/academics at the given department/institution, to reach by 27 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 35 years for men and 40 years for women. Relaxation: women 40, SC/ST/OBC Relatable as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 42,000 per month Fix.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: M.Sc. Fruit Science / PhD Fruit Science with NET.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Degree programme must be completed from ICAR/UGC recognized University/Institute. The post is purely on temporary/contractual basis.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in interview. List of eligible and non-eligible candidates with walk-in interview information will be published on www.nau.in. Original certificates are verified at the interview. No TA/DA is paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Co-terminus with the project, it will fill from date of joining to 11 months or till the grant available or date of completion of project scheme whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Navsari.
